verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a compliance and case-management SaaS that uses AI agents to automate work, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions AI training data policies, opt-outs, or data-use controls. The audit trail, export, and API features are unrelated to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
